title_en: Bu Xinguang — Application for State Compensation for Unlawful Recovery
ruling_gist_en: The revised State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, which came into effect on December 1, 2010, abolished the requirement that a compensation claimant must first undergo a confirmation procedure before applying for state compensation. In criminal compensation, where a compensation claimant believes that the organ liable for compensation has violated their personal or property rights as specified in Articles 17 and 18 of the Law, they may directly submit a compensation claim to the organ liable for compensation. If dissatisfied with the decision of the organ liable for compensation or the reconsideration organ, they may apply to the Compensation Committee of the People's Court for a compensation decision. Where a public security organ unlawfully seals up, distrains, freezes, or recovers property in the course of criminal prosecution, the victim has the right to obtain compensation. However, in this case, the public security organ lawfully returned the proceeds of crime recovered by a legally effective criminal judgment of the People's Court to the victimized entity, which did not infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of the compensation claimant, and therefore should not bear state compensation liability. The compensation claimant's application to the Compensation Committee of the People's Court for preservation measures on property unrelated to the state compensation exceeded the scope of claims provided by the State Compensation Law and is not supported.

full_text_en:
Bu Xinguang v. Anhui Provincial Public Security Department — Application for State Compensation for Illegal Recovery of Property

【Ruling Summary】

The revised State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, effective from December 1, 2010, abolished the requirement that a claimant must first go through a confirmation procedure before applying for state compensation. In criminal compensation matters, where a claimant believes that the compensation obligor has infringed upon his or her personal or property rights under Article 17 or Article 18 of the said Law, the claimant may directly submit a compensation claim to the compensation obligor. If dissatisfied with the decisions of the compensation obligor and the reconsideration body, the claimant may apply to the compensation commission of the People's Court for a compensation decision. Where a public security organ, in the course of criminal prosecution, unlawfully seals up, distrains, freezes, or recovers property, the victim has the right to obtain compensation. However, in this case, the public security organ lawfully returned the stolen goods recovered pursuant to a criminal judgment that had taken legal effect to the victim entity, and did not infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of the compensation claimant, and therefore should not bear state compensation liability. The claimant's request to the compensation commission of the People's Court to take preservation measures against property unrelated to state compensation exceeds the scope of claims provided for by the State Compensation Law and is not supported.

State Compensation Decision of the Compensation Commission of the Supreme People's Court

(2011) Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 1

Compensation Claimant: Bu Xinguang, male, born July 3, 1948, Han nationality, residing at Room 107, Building 1, Zone 2, Buxin Garden, Buxin Road, Luohu District, Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province.

Agent ad litem: Zhou Jiyun, lawyer, Anhui Jianghuai Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Zheng Jineng, lawyer, Anhui Jianghuai Law Firm.

Compensation Obligor: Anhui Provincial Public Security Department, domiciled at No. 282 Anqing Road, Hefei City, Anhui Province.

Legal Representative: Xu Liquan, Director.

Agent ad litem: Zhu Panjie, Director of the Legal Affairs Division, Anhui Provincial Public Security Department.

Agent ad litem: Wu Yong, Deputy Head of the Economic Crime Investigation Corps, Anhui Provincial Public Security Department.

Reconsideration Body: Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China, domiciled at No. 14 Dongchang'an Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing City.

Legal Representative: Meng Jianzhu, Minister.

Agent ad litem: Zhao Bin, Division Chief of the Legal Affairs Bureau, Ministry of Public Security.

Agent ad litem: Liu Xiaoli, Researcher of the Legal Affairs Bureau, Ministry of Public Security.

On December 1, 2010, the compensation claimant, Bu Xinguang, applied for state compensation on the grounds that the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department had unlawfully disposed of the land use right located at Shenkeng Village, Liu'yue, Henggang Town, Longgang District, Shenzhen City, with the property right certificate number Shen Fang Di Zi No. 6000031949 (hereinafter referred to as "Shenkeng Village Land"), causing him a loss of RMB 1.89 million and had unlawfully seized assets worth RMB 30 million. By Criminal Compensation Decision No. (2011) 01, dated January 15, 2011, the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department decided that the public security organ had lawfully returned the stolen money and property recovered by the court, without infringing upon Bu Xinguang's lawful rights and interests; the assets worth RMB 30 million claimed by Bu Xinguang involved crimes committed by others and had been dealt with in separate cases, and were unrelated to Bu Xinguang; and Bu Xinguang had no right to claim state compensation regarding the disposal of the Shenkeng Village Land. Accordingly, it decided not to grant compensation for Bu Xinguang's state compensation claim. Dissatisfied, Bu Xinguang applied for reconsideration of the state compensation decision to the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Ministry of Public Security) on February 24, 2011, requesting an order directing the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department to compensate him for direct property losses of RMB 1.89 million. On March 10 of the same year, the Ministry of Public Security received a supplementary application for reconsideration from Bu Xinguang, seeking compensation for direct property losses of RMB 5.3828 million. On May 6, 2011, the Ministry of Public Security issued Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision No. (2011) 1, holding that the land use right of the Shenkeng Village Land, valued at RMB 19.5 million, involved in Bu Xinguang's state compensation claim had been confirmed as stolen property and was ordered to be recovered by the Hefei Intermediate People's Court and the Anhui High People's Court. The public security organ's release of the seizure of the said stolen property did not harm the lawful rights and interests of the claimant. It decided to uphold the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department's Criminal Compensation Decision No. (2011) 01.

On June 8, 2011, the compensation claimant, Bu Xinguang, filed a compensation application with the Compensation Commission of this Court, contending that Criminal Compensation Decision No. (2011) 01 and Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision No. (2011) 1 were inconsistent with the facts and misapplied the law. He alleged that he had invested RMB 21.39 million in acquiring the Shenkeng Village Land, owed only RMB 8 million in principal to Shenzhen Development Bank, and had submitted to the bank an application for extension of payment and a repayment plan; that the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department had overstepped its authority by handling an economic dispute and had unlawfully used the Shenkeng Village Land he had purchased to offset his bank debt, thereby harming his interests; and that he demanded compensation from the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department for property losses of RMB 4.966 million. On September 26 of the same year, Bu Xinguang submitted a supplementary application for state compensation, requesting that the compensation for loss be amended to RMB 3.166 million (i.e., the principal of the bank debt was RMB 8 million, interest at the monthly rate of 18‰ for 71 months resulted in principal and interest totaling RMB 18.224 million, and the investment in the Shenkeng Village Land of RMB 21.39 million minus the principal and interest of RMB 18.224 million equals RMB 3.166 million). At the same time, he requested that the Compensation Commission of this Court obtain evidence from Shenzhen Xian Taoyuan Industrial Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xian Taoyuan Company) or order the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department to provide the seized financial account books to prove his investment of RMB 21.39 million in the Shenkeng Village Land. He also applied for the lawful sealing up of assets of Xian Taoyuan Company and its legal representative, Pan Xuantao, totaling RMB 288,511,700. The Compensation Commission of this Court has lawfully heard this case, and the hearing is now concluded.

Upon trial, the Compensation Commission of this Court finds the following facts:

The compensation claimant, Bu Xinguang, was placed under investigation by the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department on suspicion of the crime of forging company seals, the crime of illegally issuing financial instruments, and the crime of misappropriating funds. He was arrested on September 5, 1999. Prior to his arrest, he served as the General Manager of Shenzhen Xinhui Industrial Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xinhui Company). On October 16, 2000, the Hefei City People's Procuratorate of Anhui Province filed an indictment [No. He Jian Xing Su (2000) 65] against Bu Xinguang, charging him with the crime of forging company seals, the crime of illegally issuing financial instruments, and the crime of misappropriating funds, and initiated a public prosecution before the Hefei Intermediate People's Court. On November 20, 2001, the Hefei Intermediate People's Court rendered Criminal Judgment No. (2001) He Xing Chu Zi No. 68, finding that during his contracted management of the Shenzhen Securities Business Department of Anhui Trust and Investment Company (hereinafter referred to as Anxin Securities Department) from January 1995, Bu Xinguang, without authorization from Anhui Trust and Investment Company (hereinafter referred to as Anxin Company), arranged for personnel he had hired to secretly engrave and use the company seal exclusively belonging to Anxin Company, and used this counterfeit seal to forge Anxin Company's legal representative authorization letter, certificate of legal representative, and guarantee documents to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, thereby obtaining the business qualification for the Anxin Securities Department. His conduct constituted the crime of forging seals. During his contracted management of the Anxin Securities Department, Bu Xinguang, in violation of financial regulatory laws, issued false credit certificates to others on two occasions, causing major economic losses of RMB 10.32 million. His conduct constituted the crime of illegally issuing financial instruments. During the contracted management, as the General Manager of the Anxin Securities Department, he used his position to directly or indirectly misappropriate RMB 91,732,286 from the Anxin Securities Department for investment and various expenses of his personally owned Xinhui Company, which was unrelated to the business operations of the Anxin Securities Department. The economic losses caused were borne by the Anxin Securities Department and Anxin Company as legal liability, and this should be deemed as Bu Xinguang misappropriating funds from the securities department for personal use. His conduct constituted the crime of misappropriating funds. After the case was uncovered, the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department recovered stolen money and goods worth RMB 16,890,500; stolen goods and housing valued at RMB 16.27 million; and seized real estate worth RMB 28.4 million invested by Xinhui Company and land use rights worth RMB 19.5 million, totaling RMB 81,060,500. Since Bu Xinguang had committed multiple crimes, he should be sentenced for multiple offenses. The judgment: 1. Bu Xinguang was sentenced to two years' imprisonment for the crime of forging company seals; eight years' imprisonment for the crime of illegally issuing financial instruments; and ten years' imprisonment for the crime of misappropriating funds, with a combined sentence of fifteen years' imprisonment. 2. The stolen money and goods totaling RMB 81,060,500 were ordered to be recovered. Bu Xinguang appealed. On February 22, 2002, the Anhui High People's Court issued Criminal Ruling No. (2002) Wan Xing Zhong Zi No. 34, dismissing the appeal and affirming the original judgment. The land use right seized and ordered to be recovered in the said criminal judgment referred to the use right of the Shenkeng Village Land invested in by Bu Xinguang in the name of Xinhui Company.

It is further found that after the case involving Bu Xinguang and others suspected of misappropriating funds from the Anxin Securities Department and other related crimes came to light, Bu Xinguang fled to Indonesia on December 23, 1997. The case was assigned for jurisdiction by the Ministry of Public Security on March 9, 1998, for unified investigation by the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department. Bu Xinguang was arrested by the public security organ on September 5, 1999. Bu Xinguang was released upon completion of his sentence on August 4, 2009.

It is also found that after Bu Xinguang's criminal case was uncovered, the Renminqiao Sub-branch of Shenzhen Development Bank (formerly the business department of Shenzhen Development Bank, the same below), on the grounds of a debt dispute involving a loan of RMB 25 million with Bu Xinguang, the Anxin Securities Department, and Anxin Company, filed a civil lawsuit with the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court on December 28, 1999. The court docketed the case as No. (2000) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Diao Chu Zi No. 72. The Renminqiao Sub-branch of Shenzhen Development Bank also filed civil lawsuits with the Luohu District People's Court of Shenzhen on March 10, 2000, based on a guarantee loan dispute and a loan contract and margin deposit agreement dispute with the Anxin Securities Department and Anxin Company. These cases were docketed as No. (2000) Shen Luo Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 372 and No. (2000) Shen Luo Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 373. On April 19, 2000, the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department sent a letter to the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court and the Luohu District People's Court, requesting that, in accordance with Article 12 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Issues Concerning the Handling of Economic Crimes Suspected in the Trial of Economic Dispute Cases, the civil cases be suspended and transferred to the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department for unified investigation. On July 15, 2000, the Luohu District People's Court transferred the civil cases docketed as No. (2000) Shen Luo Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 372 and No. (2000) Shen Luo Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 373 to the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department. On August 24, 2000, the Criminal Police Corps of the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department sealed up the Shenkeng Village Land. With regard to the debt dispute case No. (2000) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Diao Chu Zi No. 72, where the Renminqiao Sub-branch of Shenzhen Development Bank sued the Anxin Securities Department and Anxin Company for a loan of RMB 25 million, the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court, after trial, found that the case involved a criminal offense and transferred the case to the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department for investigation on September 21, 2001. At the same time, it notified the Renminqiao Sub-branch of Shenzhen Development Bank, Anxin Company, and Anxin Securities Department that the civil case had been transferred. After the criminal judgment No. (2001) He Xing Chu Zi No. 68 of the Hefei Intermediate People's Court took effect, the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department released the seizure of the Shenkeng Village Land and returned the recovered land use right to the victim, the Anxin Securities Department, to cover the debt of RMB 25 million that Bu Xinguang, in the name of the Anxin Securities Department, had borrowed from Shenzhen Development Bank in the civil case No. (2000) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Diao Chu Zi No. 72 investigated by the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department.

It is further found that after Bu Xinguang's criminal case was uncovered, Shenzhen Development Bank, claiming that the Anxin Securities Department had borrowed RMB 20 million from the bank but only repaid RMB 12 million, with the remaining RMB 8 million overdue, filed a lawsuit against Bu Xinguang, the Anxin Securities Department, and Anxin Company before the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court on the grounds of a bond repurchase agreement dispute, demanding joint and several liability for the outstanding RMB 8 million and interest of RMB 3 million. On November 9, 1999, the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court issued Civil Judgment No. (1998) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 311, ordering: 1. Bu Xinguang to return RMB 2,570,016 to Shenzhen Development Bank together with interest on the RMB 20 million used during the period; 2. Where Bu Xinguang's property was insufficient to satisfy the debt, the Anxin Securities Department and Anxin Company were to bear supplementary liability for satisfaction. In the enforcement of this civil judgment, a settlement was reached between Shenzhen Development Bank and Anxin Company, and the debt was satisfied with other property.

It is also found that Xinhui Company and Xian Taoyuan Company jointly contributed to the acquisition of the Shenkeng Village Land. The land use right certificate confirmed that Xinhui Company held a 51.3% share and Xian Taoyuan Company held a 48.7% share. After the criminal judgment took effect, on November 18, 2002, the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department sent Letter No. Gong Xing Zhen (2002) 032 to Shenzhen Development Bank, stating that the losses caused to the bank by Bu Xinguang, the former head of the Anxin Securities Department, due to his criminal conduct were to be compensated by using the 51.3% interest in the Shenkeng Village Land (with an initial investment of RMB 21.39 million) as returned stolen assets to Shenzhen Development Bank, and that the public security organ would be responsible for releasing the seizure of the land use right.

The above facts are supported by: the Criminal Judgment No. (2001) He Xing Chu Zi No. 68 of the Hefei Intermediate People's Court; the Criminal Ruling No. (2002) Wan Xing Zhong Zi No. 34 of the Anhui High People's Court; the civil case files and transfer letters of the Luohu District People's Court for cases No. (2000) Shen Luo Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 372 and No. (2000) Shen Luo Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 373; the civil case file and transfer notice of the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court for case No. (2000) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Diao Chu Zi No. 72; the Civil Judgment No. (1998) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 311 of the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court; the letters [No. Gong Xing Zhen (2000) No. 09 and No. Wan Gong Xing Zi (2000) No. 031] from the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department requesting case transfer; the letter No. Gong Xing Zhen (2002) 032; the "Assistance in Enforcement Notice" [No. Gong Xing Zhen (2000) 022] of the Criminal Police Corps of the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department; the "Letter on Returning Stolen Assets" [No. Gong Xing Zhen (2002) 010]; the "Notice on Transferring Stolen Assets to Shenzhen Development Bank" [No. Gong Xing Zhen (2002) 018]; the reply letter from the Renminqiao Sub-branch of Shenzhen Development Bank; the "Agreement on Implementing the Return of Stolen Assets by the Criminal Police Corps of the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department" among Shenzhen Development Bank, and Xian Taoyuan Company; the "Lawyer's Opinion Letter" and receipt from attorney Que Liyi, authorized by Shenzhen Development Bank; and the letter from the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department to the Longgang Branch of the Shenzhen Municipal Planning and Land Bureau, among other evidence.

The Compensation Commission of this Court is of the opinion that during Bu Xinguang's contracted management of the Anxin Securities Department, without authorization from Anxin Company, he secretly engraved and used Anxin Company's seal, issued false credit certificates to others in violation of financial regulations, and misappropriated RMB 91,732,286 from the Anxin Securities Department by taking advantage of his position. The Hefei Intermediate People's Court, in Criminal Judgment No. (2001) He Xing Chu Zi No. 68, found him guilty of the crime of forging company seals, the crime of illegally issuing financial instruments, and the crime of misappropriating funds, and ordered the recovery of stolen money and goods totaling RMB 81,060,500 (including the land use right valued at RMB 19.5 million), including the use right of the Shenkeng Village Land invested in by Xinhui Company in Bu Xinguang's name. Bu Xinguang's argument that the part of the land use right purchased by Xinhui Company with his funds constituted his personal lawful property is unfounded. The effective criminal judgment of the People's Court has ordered the recovery of the use right of the Shenkeng Village Land, valued at RMB 19.5 million and invested by Xinhui Company, as part of the stolen money and goods from Bu Xinguang's crime of misappropriating funds. Bu Xinguang has no right to claim state compensation for property that has been ordered to be recovered by an effective judgment of the People's Court.

As to Bu Xinguang's claim that the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department's use of the Shenkeng Village Land to offset his debt of RMB 8 million to Shenzhen Development Bank caused him direct property losses of RMB 3.166 million: After Bu Xinguang's suspected criminal conduct came to light, Shenzhen Development Bank brought a lawsuit against Bu Xinguang, the Anxin Securities Department, and Anxin Company regarding the RMB 8 million bond repurchase agreement. The Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court issued Civil Judgment No. (1998) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Yi Chu Zi No. 311, which has been enforced. This case is not the same civil case as the debt dispute case No. (2000) Shen Zhong Fa Jing Diao Chu Zi No. 72, transferred to the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department for investigation on September 21, 2001, in which Shenzhen Development Bank sued Bu Xinguang, the Anxin Securities Department, and Anxin Company for a loan of RMB 25 million. After the criminal judgment took effect, the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department returned the recovered use right of the Shenkeng Village Land, valued at RMB 19.5 million, to the victim in the case it had investigated concerning Bu Xinguang's borrowing of RMB 25 million from Shenzhen Development Bank in the name of the Anxin Securities Department. This action had a factual basis and did not harm Bu Xinguang's interests. Bu Xinguang's claim that the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department used the Shenkeng Village Land to offset his debt of RMB 8 million to Shenzhen Development Bank is inconsistent with the facts. Bu Xinguang's request for compensation of RMB 3.166 million from the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department for the unlawful return of the Shenkeng Village Land lacks factual and legal basis.

Regarding Bu Xinguang's application to the Compensation Commission of this Court for obtaining evidence from Xian Taoyuan Company to prove his investment of RMB 21.39 million in the acquisition of the Shenkeng Village Land, or for ordering the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department to provide the seized financial account books: Bu Xinguang requested the Compensation Commission of the People's Court to obtain evidence to prove his investment of RMB 21.39 million in the Shenkeng Village Land. However, the effective criminal judgment found that the investment value of the land use right was RMB 19.5 million, and it has been lawfully recovered. Bu Xinguang no longer has any lawful rights or interests in the use right of the Shenkeng Village Land. Therefore, the Compensation Commission of this Court does not support Bu Xinguang's application to obtain this evidence.

As to Bu Xinguang's request that the Compensation Commission of this Court lawfully seal up assets of Xian Taoyuan Company and Pan Xuantao individually, totaling RMB 288,511,700: After the criminal judgment took effect, the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department released the seizure of the Shenkeng Village Land use right and returned it to the Anxin Securities Department. Subsequently, in November 2002, Xian Taoyuan Company received the land use right that had been ordered to be recovered by the judgment. In 2010, the Shenzhen Municipal Government expropriated the Shenkeng Village Land and paid compensation of RMB 288,511,700 to Xian Taoyuan Company. This compensation is unrelated to Bu Xinguang. Therefore, Bu Xinguang's request for the Compensation Commission of this Court to seal up this compensation amount and Pan Xuantao's personal assets lacks legal basis.

In summary, the Shenkeng Village Land has been ordered to be recovered by the Criminal Ruling No. (2002) Wan Xing Zhong Zi No. 34 of the Anhui High People's Court. The compensation claimant Bu Xinguang's claim that the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department's unlawful return of the land caused him a loss of RMB 3.166 million lacks legal basis. The other claims of the compensation claimant Bu Xinguang have no factual basis and do not comply with the provisions of the State Compensation Law, and are not supported. The Criminal Compensation Decision No. (2011) 01 of the Anhui Provincial Public Security Department and the Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision No. (2011) 1 of the Ministry of Public Security, which decided not to grant compensation for Bu Xinguang's state compensation claim, were procedurally lawful and correctly applied the law. Pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 2, Article 28, and Article 29 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 19, Item (1) of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Procedures for the Compensation Commission of People's Courts in Hearing State Compensation Cases, the Compensation Commission of this Court decides as follows:

We affirm the Criminal Compensation Decision of the Public Security Department of Anhui Province (Wan Gong Xing Pei Zi [2011] No. 01) and the Criminal Compensation Review Decision of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China (Gong Pei Fu Zi [2011] No. 1).

This decision is a legally effective decision.

November 24, 2011
